chars.Y: YOUNES: a young muscular man wearing a white linen short-sleeve shirt and beige chino trousers, brown leather sandals.
chars.L: LADY: an elegant slim woman wearing a long emerald-green silk dress, gold bracelets and gold hoop earrings.
chars.H: HUSBAND: a very tall heavy-set man wearing black sunglasses, a black suit with an open black shirt and a thick gold chain, intimidating mafia boss look.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At a luxury Moroccan palace hotel swimming pool in Marrakech with palm trees and arches, LADY sits on a sun lounger and secretly winks at YOUNES who stands nearby surprised; behind her, HUSBAND stands with arms crossed glaring suspiciously at YOUNES. Tense moment.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a luxurious Moroccan hotel lounge with zellige tiles and lanterns, LADY leans close and whispers into YOUNES's ear while discreetly pointing toward a corridor sign-less door of the spa; YOUNES listens excitedly.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Elegant Moroccan hotel spa corridor with carved wooden doors and candles; YOUNES walks in nervously looking around and finds LADY waiting alone at the end of the corridor, smiling mysteriously.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a calm Moroccan spa waiting room, LADY sits and talks seriously, gesturing with one hand as if explaining something about a man; YOUNES sits opposite her, worried and asking a question.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the spa room, LADY hands YOUNES a hotel room key card with a sly smile, putting a finger on her lips to say keep it secret; YOUNES takes it, excited and nervous.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A luxurious Moroccan palace hotel suite hallway with a big carved wooden door; YOUNES knocks and LADY opens the door smiling and invites him in, a lavish suite with arches and lanterns visible behind her.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside the lavish Moroccan hotel suite, YOUNES sits relaxed on a velvet sofa next to LADY, both laughing; suddenly the main door handle in the background starts turning, YOUNES's head turns toward the door in surprise.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the luxurious Moroccan hotel suite, LADY points at the door in panic with wide eyes, while YOUNES jumps up from the sofa terrified, sweating, looking for a place to hide.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the doorway of the luxurious Moroccan hotel suite, HUSBAND stands huge and menacing, holding up his smartphone filming them; YOUNES freezes in shock in the middle of the room and LADY stands calmly beside him. Dramatic tense moment.
